title: Shotmaster PM Runbook
subtitle: Eversys Shotmaster (Enigma range) | c, s, ms, s-pro, ms-pro (Classic and ST) | preventive maintenance kits and steps
sources: Based on the Enigma | Shotmaster | E'choco PM Kits Manual V4.0 (SAP 5700111715, 01.05.2026), TI-240, and the e'Support history of service kit releases V3.0 (12.10.2026). The older e'line Shotmaster uses the E'line runbook. Check the Webshop configurator with the machine's serial number before ordering.

banners.text: Updated October 2026 to the PM Kits Manual V4.0: 24-month kits are now 36-month kits (TI-240). Old 24-month kits in stock can be used for the 36-month PM.
Shotmaster c has no steam boiler: no steam, hot water or milk kits. Katz lists these units as "Shotmaster CT" (serials starting 01153900 Classic, 01166200 ST).
No milk system on this model, so milk-module and frame kits are not listed.
12-month PM: only 12-month kits are listed. Hydraulic kits and the Everfoam, milk and hot water add-ons are 36-month items.

kits.name: Brew module Standard
kits.note: One per brew unit. Includes tube 108153 (Ø4/Ø2, 245 mm) and tube 104528 (Ø4/Ø2, 180 mm).

kits.name: Hydraulic add-on, E'choco
kits.note: x2 on every Shotmaster, Pro included. NetSuite name: Kit - Solenoid Valve 25mm - ODE (same kit).

kits.name: Milk module V2 Standard, long interval
Frame add-on, 1.5-Step
kits.note: Cut tubes to the machine's dimensions.

kits.name: E'choco Standard
kits.note: O-ring 118259 x2 (Ø6.07x1.78) in the V4.0 kit.

kits.name: E'choco add-on, 2 outlets
kits.note: Silicone pipe 110301 x2 (Ø9/6, 70 mm, cut from 1 m pipe 111629).

items.text: Check ground-coffee total: change burrs after every 2000 kg.
Clean the grinder at every service.
Clean, then apply a thin layer of grease (JAX Pyro-plate FGN) to the threads of the upper burr support.
Fit kit EV117077 on each brew unit.
Clean, then grease the shafts of the bottom arm and the top piston with JAX Pyro-plate FGN.
Check the piston screens for clogging. Clean or replace if needed.
Turn each piston screen 1/4 turn to lock it, then tighten the piston head to 8 N·m.
Fit EV109586 on each hydraulic module.
Fit EV102865 for E'choco.
Fit EV109590 for the adjustable Americano.
Check the heating element and boiler for scale. Descale with Eversys descaler (PI-19) if needed.
Fit EV108389 and the steam add-ons listed in section 2.
Apply Loctite Permabond MM115 pure to the thread of the air injector when reassembling.
Check the heating element and boiler for scale. Descale with Eversys descaler (PI-19) if needed.
Fit EV108339 on each milk module.
Fit EV108340 on each milk module.
Change the milk pipes (every 12 months). 25 m blue 106186, green 106189.
Apply Loctite Permabond MM115 pure to the thread of the air injector when reassembling.
Fit the frame add-on kits listed in section 2 (EV108351 and/or EV108364).
Cut the tubes to the machine's dimensions. Clean the 1.5-Step outlet, the fitting silicone pipe and the aerator.
Fit EV109706.
Fit EV111934 for the second outlet.
Record the service (date, interval, kits used). Old 24-month kits may be used for the 36-month interval.

stockNote.title: 24-month kits in stock are still usable.
stockNote.text: Per TI-240 (from 1 May 2026) the 24-month kits are replaced by 36-month kits, and existing 24-month kits can be used for the 36-month interval. 12-month kits are unchanged. Old full-machine kit PM-KIT SHOTMASTER - 24M (103096) is not in the V4.0 manual: order the module kits instead.

supersessions: Steam add-ons now 36 months; hot water kits trimmed.
Grinder Standard, Frame Standard and outlet V2. Deleted.

reference.title: Interval rule
reference.text: Under 50,000 cycles a year per group head: 12-month PM in years 1 and 2, 36-month PM in year 3, then repeat. Over 50,000: the same 12, 12, 36 pattern every 50,000 cycles. At least one PM a year is mandatory.

reference.title: Identify the model from the serial
reference.text: First 8 digits of the serial (e'Support, List of machine serial numbers - North America). Classic: c 01153900, s 01160000, ms 01160100. ST: c 01166200, s 01166300, ms 01166400, s-pro 01166500, ms-pro 01166600. The e'line Shotmaster (00999300) uses the E'line runbook.
